answers.1: Yellow + Green – both are people-oriented, warm and harmony-seeking, so they click socially (Red + Yellow also click, being the two outgoing types)
answers.2: Red + Blue – both task-focused: Red drives the result, Blue secures the quality (Green + Blue is the other natural working pair, both methodical)
answers.4: Blue – precision, procedure, zero tolerance for error; ideally Blue with a dash of Red for cool decisiveness under pressure
answers.8: Blue (Green is dependable too, but Blue is punctual by principle)
answers.9: Red – results beat rules (Yellow also bends rules, but out of chaos rather than drive)
answers.10: Red – will try anything that gets the job done faster; Yellow loves novelty for its own sake
answers.11: Green – takes it personally and stores it quietly for years
answers.16: Red – forms an opinion instantly (Yellow also judges fast, but on feeling rather than efficiency)
answers.17: All four – Red + Yellow + Green + Blue in balance; no single pair is best for every task
answers.19: Yellow – quick, enthusiastic, open to novelty (Red grasps it just as fast but only asks 'is it useful?')
answers.20: Red – delegates, gets impatient, takes it back (Blue redoes it too, but for quality reasons)
answers.23: No single answer – your circle usually mirrors your own colour (like attracts like); statistically Green is the most common type overall
